blindSummary:
This state/province is the national capital district: it recorded 2 killings of trans and travesti people in 2025, a low absolute count for a major metropolitan area. It is the seat of the federal supreme court, the national protective apparatus and the offices of human-rights bodies; the national trans-association compiles and reports its dossier from desks located here. The district hosts international diplomatic missions and NGO infrastructure that raise the visibility and institutional cost of anti-trans violence.

That institutional visibility is qualitative, not numerical: the 2 killings against ~3 million population give a rate of ~0.67 per million, above the national per-million rate. Its lower absolute numbers and concentration of protective infrastructure contrast with the country's most populous state/province, which also leads in institutional capacity but recorded 4 killings in 2025 and 16 in 2024.
